name: Long-Range Wi-Fi
description: A directional antenna dramatically extends the range at which Wi-Fi attacks can be conducted — from tens of meters to several hundred meters depending on antenna gain and environment. A cantenna is a DIY directional antenna built from a cylindrical metal can. This technique allows engagement of a target's wireless network from a parked vehicle or neighboring property, well outside the physical perimeter.

blue.det: Unusual high-gain antenna visible near facility; WIDS may detect strong signal source from outside normal range; evil twin or passive capture session visible in wireless logs.
blue.cm: Wireless Intrusion Detection System (WIDS); minimize signal leakage outside building; 5GHz preferred for shorter range; 802.1X preventing credential capture.
